description: For a sole trader: the share of each invoice to set aside for Self Assessment, this year's income tax and Class 4 NI bill, the 31 January and 31 July payments, and whether a reserve covers the next one. Use for 'how much should I put aside for tax?'.

expenses.description: Allowable expenses this tax year, in pounds. Defaults to 0.

firstYear.description: True for the first year of Self Assessment. Defaults to false.

reserve.description: Current tax reserve balance, in pounds. Optional.

scotland.description: True for Scottish income tax rates. Defaults to where they live, from Settings - false if not said.

turnover.description: Expected turnover this tax year, in pounds.
